test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 1st November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ZOMBIE is written as BEIMOZ, and FLEX is written as EFLX. How will PRODUCT be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :

Alphabet positional values are arranged in increasing order.

ZOMBIE is written as BEIMOZ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86b246800b3718763673f2f71463e88161698d0c9b5bfdfc0e75fba51fccf6a9.png] 

And

FLEX is written as EFLX.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e13190e2a08cb4417d2718ca88e3b81eeed102940e14c53c58f23ded31957511.png] 

Similarly,

PRODUCT will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/645e64785fa7dc3d55b97ab8f45da180ab85bd84af9e3fc2246729b47930742a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CDOPRTU".**
